content:
Rafi: Thinking out loud  mini challenge for Thursday chill: couch + projector + randomizer mod speedrun night? 30min rounds, losers buy snacks. :popcorn:
Maya: Wait, randomizer how? Isaac/SMW style or a pick-your-game hat?
Ben: I vote hat. Write game names on sticky notes, pull two, random seed decides modifiers.
Sofia: Ill bring my old Joy-Cons and a GameCube controller adapter. Also snacks if Im not late.
Rafi: Great. Seed ideas: 1) 'item chaos' 2) 'enemy swap' 3) 'tiny-hits' 4) 'no-run' — pick one per round.
Maya: :laughing: "tiny-hits" sounds brutal. Also can we do a cooperative round? Not everyone wants to speedrun solo.
Ben: Co-op rounds welcome. Maybe alternate solo and co-op so folks can spectate and meme.
Sofia: I can stream the projector feed to the #random channel for remote folks. Quick question: do we want to time runs with OBS or just use phone stopwatch?
Rafi: OBS preferred so we have a recording. Ben, youre on scenes?
Ben: Yup, will set up a scene with camera + fullscreen capture. If anyone wants to submit a 60s intro clip, DM me.
Maya: Poll: start at 18:30 or 19:00? Reply with 18:30/19:00.
Ben: 19:00 (need to wrap a standup)
Sofia: 18:30 please, movie night afterwards.
Rafi: Majority wins -> 19:00. Ill update event. Bring controllers, chargers, and questionable snack choices. :taco:
ops-bot: Event created: "Couch Arcade: Randomizer Speedrun Night" Thu 19:00  mezzanine. RSVP: https://calendar.company/e/couch-arcade-randomizer
Maya: Also can we do a 10min warmup with Rocket League? Fast and chaotic.
Ben: Warmup + 3 rounds of shuffle + 1 coop match. See you Thursday :rocket:
